answer: Reputation collateral that cannot be pledged twice limits a farm to one seat per earned history. Each epoch a seat must pledge a relic: a non-transferable record of its own past graded answers, hashed into the ledger. The yarrow draw, a public random beacon, then picks three of those past answers for fresh re-grading by unrelated jurors. A relic pledged by two seats in one epoch is voided for both, and one whose sampled answers prove a fable, never actually graded, earns nothing. Each extra fake needs its own genuine history, re-verified every epoch.
